mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signal inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) over 3 months supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recoveries, rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chains that boost corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recoveries when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
